shared_schema.input: Exact keys: schema_version=1, query nonempty string containing a word, allowlisted_hosts lowercase exact ASCII hostnames, urls HTTPS URL list, fixtures list of {url,title,content_type,body,synthetic:true}. Content type is text/html or text/plain.
shared_schema.output: schema_version=1, status=ok, query, synthetic=true, sources, findings, warnings. Sources retain canonical URL, title, normalized text, content type, raw UTF-8 body SHA-256 and retrieval mode. Findings retain source index, URL, title, hash, exact quote, normalized-text character offsets [start,end), and matched query terms.
shared_schema.error: schema_version=1, status=error, error message; CLI exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validation module validates input before retrieval and checks evidence provenance before output. Unknown keys, duplicate JSON keys, unsupported schemes, credentials, ports, unallowlisted hosts and mislabeled fixtures are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated canonical URLs -> synthetic fixture retrieval -> normalized visible text with body digest -> query-matched evidence with verified offsets
behavior: Offline retrieval exclusively from clearly labeled synthetic input fixtures; never performs network or provider calls.
Exact host allowlisting, not suffix matching. HTTPS default port only. Fragments stripped; host case normalized; query preserved. Canonical request duplicates are removed in first-seen order.
Missing fixtures yield explicit warnings and successful partial results. Empty or unmatched documents yield no findings.
HTML text extraction suppresses script, style, noscript and template content; whitespace is normalized. It is not a browser renderer.
Deterministic sentence-like splitting and case-insensitive whole-word query matching. Findings are extractive evidence, not fact verification or generated summaries.
No LLM step is required. No injected callable is used.
Bounds: 100 requested URLs, hosts and fixtures; 100000 characters per body; 12 MB input file limit checked after reading.
